scope: Add bounded malformed DICTIONARY OBJECTS-body recovery and CLI disposition controls across six DWG revisions.

source.kind: scratch-only DWGs authored at test runtime by the in-tree DWG writer; the valid DICTIONARY seed is converted to a raw mutated frame and injected into a malformed carrier
source.object: The valid DICTIONARY seed is registered under the named-object dictionary and has an empty entry list. Its mutated raw frame is injected into a scratch carrier with the standard NOD present but without a named-object dictionary membership entry for the failed frame. The one-bit search begins after a valid common prologue and stays within the declared body span.

implementation.controls: Each mutated source reads successfully with one object parse failure, zero entity parse failures, one failed object frame, exact source-frame accounting, and the following LINE callback. Strict ASCII/Binary conversion preserves the destination sentinel. Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion succeeds and reopens with the retained LINE and VPORT. AC1027 reader recovery passes, while both CLI modes stop at the established source-reference qualification gate. The malformed carrier is designed for framed parser-recovery policy and does not qualify dictionary membership closure.

results.outputQualification: AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032 pass strict refusal plus explicit-partial ASCII/Binary readback. AC1027 remains reader-only at the source-reference gate.

limitations: Generated parser-recovery and CLI disposition evidence only; the malformed carrier does not establish DICTIONARY membership closure, application semantics, producer prevalence, or interoperability.
